# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 75 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 75

**1** Jesus said: "Many are waiting at the door, but only those who are truly alone will enter the wedding chamber."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Waiting at the door" — more dynamic than standing; anticipation implied
- "Truly alone" — the *monachos* as those who have achieved genuine aloneness/singleness
- "Wedding chamber" — slightly more accessible than "bridal chamber" without losing the nuptial meaning
